brief:
The transport sector in Gaza faces imminent collapse as fuel shortages and infrastructure damage threaten to paralyze movement across the territory, the Ma'an news agency reported. Ongoing blockade conditions and limited access to fuel supplies have severely restricted commercial and public transportation operations.

The crisis compounds existing challenges in the enclave's already-strained economy and humanitarian situation, leaving residents increasingly isolated and unable to access essential services that depend on functioning transport networks.
title: Gaza's transport sector faces collapse
